name: Kvasice (Czechia)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and red in the ratio 3:1:1, with a white forked arrow in the upper red at the hoist.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 15 November 2005 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
